quantity.name: ROM
quantity.definition: L1-L2 intervertebral rotation at 7.5 Nm (FL-EX total; LB and AR one side), quasi-static, mean +- SD, n=6

source.sample: 6 fresh-frozen human cadaveric T12-L2 segments screened for degeneration; facet loads at L1-L2 (gauges on L2 superior facets)

protocol.summary: T12-L2 specimens, end vertebrae potted in fixture cups; pure moments 7.5 Nm in FL, EX, right/left AR, right/left LB (standard flexibility test, Crawford 1995): 3 preconditioning cycles at peak load, then quasi-static 1.5 Nm increments to 7.5 Nm, each held 45 s; no preload; facet capsules intact.
how_to_simulate: Fix L2; apply pure moments to T12, no preload
Apply 7.5 Nm in FL/EX, LB and AR
Report L1-L2 rotation: flexion+extension total, lateral bending and axial rotation one side
protocol.notes: Method: four-gauge strain pads on lateral L2 superior articular processes (extra-articular, capsule intact); specimen-specific neural-network models (NeuralWorks Predict) trained on post hoc calibration loads 5-125 N at up to 12 points per facet; load RMSD < 11 N (Table 1). Strain gauges cannot measure tension; values are compressive contact loads.
